title: I HATE leaf litter
description: adds a leafblower that can quickly remove lots of leaf litter
body:
adds a cheap item that collects leaf litter blocks in a big area and drops them at your feet. adds a way to make leaf litter useful too - you can now turn it into planks instead of just smelting it!!!


![leafblower recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9431c8817568a198d1b12bf11e9f0eb951c1b430.png)
